title: Comparing instants
hints: A time.Time holds a location as well as an instant. == compares both, so 12:00 UTC and 14:00 in UTC+2 are not ==, even though they are the same moment.
Use a.Equal(b) to compare instants. For ordering, use Before and After.
Bookings that only touch (one ends exactly when the other starts) don't overlap: a.Start.Before(b.End) && b.Start.Before(a.End).
